hero.subtitle: AI-powered mind mapping that understands your ideas, suggests connections, and helps you learn faster.
hero.receipt: No email. No card. Your map auto-saves to this browser.
hero.subtitle_v2: Drop in an idea. Connect it to another. Ask the AI to keep going. NeuroCanvas turns scattered notes into structured maps — without the cards-and-folders ceremony.

ai_expansion.title: AI-Powered Expansion
ai_expansion.description: Select any node and let AI suggest related concepts, definitions, and connections. Supports OpenAI, Claude, and local models.

infinite_canvas.title: Infinite Canvas
infinite_canvas.description: Pan, zoom, and navigate freely. Force-directed layouts keep your maps organized. Minimap for orientation in large maps.

cross_platform.title: Web, Desktop, Mobile
cross_platform.description: Use the web app anywhere, install the desktop app via Tauri, or take it on the go with iOS and Android via Capacitor.

realtime_sync.title: Real-time Sync
realtime_sync.description: Conflict-free sync powered by Yjs. Your maps stay consistent across all devices, even offline. Auto-save included.

semantic_engine.title: Semantic Engine
semantic_engine.description: Embedding-based similarity search discovers hidden connections. Semantic clustering reveals patterns in your thinking.

export.title: Export Anywhere
export.description: Export as PNG for presentations, JSON for data portability, or Markdown for clean hierarchical outlines.

cta.heading: Ready to think differently?
cta.subtitle: Free, open-source, and built for students. Available on every platform you use.

mini_canvas.live_chip: live · pan · zoom · drag in production
mini_canvas.prompt_example: Generate from a sentence — “plan a launch for our pgvector release”

section_01.heading: Notes apps gave you folders. Mind-map tools gave you trees. Neither of them helped you think.
section_01.paragraph: NeuroCanvas treats every idea as a node and every connection as a link in your reasoning. The AI sits inside the canvas — not in a sidebar — so it can extend, regroup, or summarize the part you're working on, without breaking your flow.

section_02.heading: Type one sentence. Get a structured map back.
section_02.prompt_text: Plan a launch for our new pgvector RAG search — engineering, content, and rollout.

section_03.heading: Three primitives. Nothing else to learn.

step_1.label: Node
step_1.title: Double-click anywhere. Type an idea.
step_1.body: No folders, no titles, no schema. The canvas grows infinitely in every direction. You don't decide where things go up-front — you arrange after the fact, when patterns emerge.

step_2.label: Edge
step_2.title: Drag from one node to another to connect them.
step_2.body: Connections are typed (causes, contradicts, depends on, leads to). Edges become the *reasoning* — not just the visual link. Filter the canvas by edge type to isolate one chain of thought.

step_3.label: AI
step_3.title: Select a node. Press ⌘K. Ask for more.
step_3.body: "Expand this branch with counter-arguments." "Summarize the left subtree as a paragraph." "Find which two nodes contradict each other." The AI works on the part you've selected — never the whole canvas.

section_04.heading: A blank canvas is sometimes the wrong start. Pick a shape, then make it yours.

template_research.title: Research synthesis
template_research.description: Sources cluster. AI summarizes the cluster.

section_05.heading: Your maps live where you do. Not on someone else's GPU.

col_local.title: Local-first storage
col_local.body: SQLite on disk. Your canvas works offline. Sync only when you're signed in.

col_byok.title: Bring your own AI key
col_byok.body: Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or local Ollama. Keys stay encrypted in our vault — we never train on your maps.

col_export.title: Open format, exportable
col_export.body: Export to JSON, Markdown, or PNG anytime. The schema is documented. Your data is portable by default.

final_cta.heading: Stop writing notes you'll never read. Start mapping.
final_cta.receipt: Free, forever. No card. No invitation. Your work auto-saves to this browser.
